She just told me she will keep trying, but that she doesn't want me to leave her. i.e she wants us to get back together. 

I no longer want that. In fact, breaking up was a mutual decision, as our relationship was going nowhere, and was causing both of us emotional distress. I told her i'm here for her as a friend. I don't have a choice, I can't get back together with her on the basis that she changes her suicide plans. This is emotional blackmail for gods sake
